article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 19 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Hoosier Hot Shots, The Story Lady, and Pepper Young's Family
article-meta.kwd-group: Hoosier Hot Shots, The Story Lady, Georgene Faulkner, Pepper Youngs Family, Washboard Jazz, Fairytales, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 25 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 25 resolves 19 historical master recordings: 8 wartime syndicated musical comedy transcriptions of ***The Hoosier Hot Shots*** (featuring their signature washboard, slide whistle, and novelty jazz hits like *Rosie the Riveter* and *Sioux City Sue*), 8 delightful 1947 fairytale broadcasts from ***The Story Lady*** (narrated by pioneering radio storyteller Georgene Faulkner), and 3 pre-war 1941 master episodes of Elaine Carrington's beloved daytime drama ***Pepper Young's Family***.

sec.title: 1. *The Hoosier Hot Shots* — 1944–1945 Syndicated Transcription Discs Dated
sec.p: Ken Trietsch, Paul 'Hezzie' Trietsch, Charles Ward, and Frank Kettering in top musical form:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Novelty Repertoire | |---|---|---|---| | `Hoosier_Hot_Shots_Rosie_The_Riviter_Ep127.mp3` | **"The Hoosier Hot Shots: Rosie the Riveter (Episode 127)"** | **1944-09-18** | Famous WWII factory worker tribute song arranged for washboard and kazoos. | | `Hoosier_Hot_Shots_Sioux_City_Sue_Ep140.mp3` | **"The Hoosier Hot Shots: Sioux City Sue (Episode 140)"** | **1944-12-18** | Western novelty hit sung in four-part rustic harmony. | | `Hoosier_Hot_Shots_Daniel_Boone_Ep27.mp3` | **"The Hoosier Hot Shots: Daniel Boone (Episode 27)"** | **1944-02-14** | Frontier folk parody and comedic instrumental breakdown. | | `Hoosier_Hot_Shots_Fit_As_A_Fiddle_Ep43.mp3` | **"The Hoosier Hot Shots: Fit as a Fiddle (Episode 43)"** | **1944-04-17** | Upbeat jazz standard played on slide whistle, clarinet, and washboard. | | `Hoosier_Hot_Shots_Four_Thousand_Years_Ago_Ep45.mp3` | **"The Hoosier Hot Shots: Four Thousand Years Ago (Episode 45)"** | **1944-04-24** | Comedic ancient history song with Hezzie's signature horn honks. | | `Hoosier_Hot_Shots_Take_Me_Out_To_Ball_Ep153.mp3` | **"The Hoosier Hot Shots: Take Me Out to the Ball Game (Episode 153)"** | **1945-04-09** | Opening Day baseball novelty tribute. | | `Hoosier_Hot_Shots_There_Be_Changes_Ep177.mp3` | **"The Hoosier Hot Shots: There'll Be Some Changes Made (Episode 177)"** | **1945-09-24** | Hot jazz tune with dizzying clarinet and slide whistle solos. | | `Hoosier_Hot_Shots_Annabelle_Ep7.mp3` | **"The Hoosier Hot Shots: Annabelle (Episode 7)"** | **1944-01-10** | Romantic novelty song delivered with comic country banter. |
